name: WOKING 800

specs.notes: McLaren's Senna (2018): the 4.0 twin-turbo V8 at 800 PS (588 kW) and 800 N m, a seven-speed dual clutch, 1,198 kg dry (~1,310 kg kerb), 800 kg of downforce at 250 km/h, 340 km/h, a 2,670 mm wheelbase (Wikipedia, WhichCar). Its torque curve, ratios and aero are estimates.

garage.blurb: A road-legal track weapon: 800 horsepower, a wing taller than you, and downforce that pins it to the road at speed.

interior.notes: The model's own cabin: its steering wheel cut out to turn (tools/cars/senna.json), the eye placed by hand from section views; an automatic or dual clutch: the hands stay on the wheel.
